verdict.rationale: ZCode is an AI coding workbench whose agents work on the user's own project. It runs multi-agent collaboration and Goal-driven planning, execution and verification (zcode-docs-1, zcode-docs-2), and offers built-in multimodal analysis of screenshots and images via GLM-5.3-Flash (zcode-docs-4). That implies AI-generated analysis and suggestions over user content, but the evidence never frames this as surfacing insights from the user's data, and it comes only from vendor claims. Missing for 10: explicit data-insight or suggestion features, documentation of what user data is analyzed and how insights are presented, and independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
